prerequisite: All DEV-044A seeds 4401-4403 and independent audit must pass before loading selected representations
inputs: Frozen pre-head 44-dimensional readout features for WAIT/SERVICE concatenated; probability_joint receives only original WAIT/SERVICE probabilities. No privileged state, role or target ID.

losses.probability_joint: same joint objective, probability inputs only

selection: Thresholds selected independently per head using calibration physical cost; tie nearest 0.25 then threshold. No evaluation selection.
primary: paired seed difference in physical cost/entity versus tuned original threshold, with failure guard
integrity: disjoint public-history fingerprints across all splits
independent checkpoint prediction and physical replay
save every head and negative result
limitations: service is reliable in this simulator
offline cost supervision is not on-policy ActionOPD
no INSPECT superiority claim without receipt policy
equal head updates do not imply equal total compute
no confirmatory or full-system superiority claim
